q-125135.name: Question 2
q-125135.problem: Let $b=[\begin{aligned}8 \\ -6\end{aligned}].$ Find a unit vector that is parallel to $b$ and points the same direction.
q-125135.worked_solution:
Remember that to find a unit vector that is parallel to a given vector, we need to divide the given vector by its length:

$$
\begin{aligned}u & =\frac{b}{|\,b\,|}\end{aligned}
$$

Using the formula for the magnitude of a vector, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}|\,b\,| & =\sqrt{{8}^{2}+(-6)^{2}} \\  & =\sqrt{64+36} \\  & =\sqrt{100} \\  & =10.\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we divide $b$ by its length and get the following unit vector:

$$
\begin{aligned}u & =\frac{b}{|b|} \\  & =\frac{1}{10}\cdot b \\  & =\frac{1}{10}\cdot [\begin{aligned}8 \\ -6\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{4}{5} \\ -\frac{3}{5}\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

q-98330.problem: Which of the following curves is simple, closed, and positively oriented?
q-98330.worked_solution:
A simple closed curve is positively oriented if, when traveling along it, one always has the curve interior to the left and the curve exterior to the right. Otherwise, the curve is negatively oriented. 

A curve is positively oriented if it is traversed counterclockwise and is negatively oriented if it is traversed clockwise.
